tools.name: ap_upload
tools.description:
Upload an image or video to AP and print the reusable R2 key and asset ID.

Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC, HEIF; max 8 MiB. AP normalizes images to still JPEGs. Resize or convert larger files before uploading.

For an image post, use the returned asset ID with `ap post create --format image --upload-asset-id <id>`. For carousels, use ordered `--media asset:<id>` inputs. R2 keys can be reused for video posts only. File inputs are same-machine paths because this MCP server is running locally.

tools.name: ap_post_create
tools.description:
Create a video, image, carousel, or text-only AP post.

Publishes immediately unless a schedule is supplied. Discover connected providers with `linkme ap accounts`.

Text supports facebook,x,threads,linkedin and requires a nonblank caption with no media. Images and carousels also support instagram,tiktok. YouTube supports video only.

Carousel limits: instagram/facebook 10, threads/linkedin 20, tiktok 35, x 4. Only instagram/threads accept video items; other carousels must contain images. File inputs are same-machine paths because this MCP server is running locally.

format.description: Post format; image/media inputs infer image/carousel, otherwise video. Text requires explicit text format

image.description: Image file (max 8 MiB) or asset:<id> for a finalized image; bare R2 keys are not accepted

uploadAssetId.description: Asset ID returned by ap upload; set format to image for images. Alternative to image/video input

media.description: 2–35 distinct files or asset:<id> references in publishing order; repeat --media for each item. Cannot combine with image/video/upload-asset-id

video.description: Path to a video file or an AP R2 key

caption.description: Caption (max 2200 characters); required and nonblank for text, optional for media posts

schedule.description: Schedule the post with an ISO 8601 datetime

youtubeTitle.description: YouTube video title (falls back to the shared caption)

image.description: Image file (max 8 MiB) or asset:<id> for a finalized image; bare R2 keys are not accepted

uploadAssetId.description: Asset ID returned by ap upload; set format to image for images. Alternative to image/video input

media.description: 2–35 distinct files or asset:<id> references in publishing order; repeat --media for each item. Cannot combine with image/video/upload-asset-id

video.description: Path to a video file or an AP R2 key

caption.description: Caption (max 2200 characters); required and nonblank for text, optional for media posts

schedule.description: Schedule the post with an ISO 8601 datetime

youtubeTitle.description: YouTube video title (falls back to the shared caption)

youtubeDescription.description: YouTube video description (falls back to the shared caption)

youtubePrivacy.description: YouTube privacy status: public, unlisted, or private

tools.name: linkme_show_post
tools.description: Show a live-updating card for one AP post: media, caption, schedule, and per-platform delivery with published links, errors, and retry/publish/cancel actions. Use after creating a post or when the user asks how a post is doing.

postId.description: AP post id, for example from ap_post_create or ap_post_list

tools.name: linkme_show_calendar
tools.description: Show the user's AP content calendar for a month: scheduled, published, failed, and in-progress posts with thumbnails and per-platform status, plus filters. Opens as an agenda and expands to a month grid. Use when the user asks what is scheduled or posted.

month.description: Month to show as YYYY-MM; defaults to the current month

statusGroup.description: Only show posts in this status group

provider.description: Only show posts targeting this platform

search.description: Only show posts whose caption matches

tools.name: linkme_show_accounts
tools.description: Show which social platforms are connected to Linkme for cross-posting, which need reconnecting, and plan limits, with one-click connect and reconnect. Use when the user wants to connect, check, or fix platform accounts.

provider.description: Platform the user wants to connect or check; it is highlighted

tools.name: linkme_show_insights
tools.description: Show an analytics dashboard: follower and engagement metrics for every connected social account, plus link-in-bio visits, clicks, CTR, and top traffic sources for the last 7, 30, or 90 days. Use when the user asks how they are doing or wants performance numbers.

tools.name: linkme_studio
tools.description: Open Linkme Publishing Studio fullscreen: the content calendar, connected platform accounts, and insights in one place. Use when the user wants to plan or manage their publishing broadly.

tab.description: Section to open first: calendar (default), accounts, or insights

instructions:
Linkme MCP server: programmatic access to the Linkme platform.

Interactive views: linkme_compose_post opens a reviewable draft (prefer it over ap_post_create unless the user asked to publish without review); linkme_show_post, linkme_show_calendar, linkme_show_accounts, linkme_show_insights, and linkme_studio render live UI. After a view renders, do not restate what it shows.

Auth: set the LINKME_TOKEN environment variable, or run 'linkme auth login' beforehand to use stored credentials.

All tools return stable JSON DTOs (the same shape as the CLI's --json output). Tool names follow an area_command convention (e.g. links_list, ap_post_create).

Tool annotations (readOnlyHint / destructiveHint / idempotentHint) describe expected behavior, but destructive tools execute immediately without a confirmation prompt — check annotations and tool descriptions before calling them.

Major areas: profile, links, ap (Post on All Platforms), automations, commerce, shop, creator finance, email, analytics, contacts, courses, feeds, reviews, and permission-scoped ads.

File inputs are paths on the same machine as this local MCP server.
